arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, sys, stat, json, asyncio, hashlib, subprocess
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
path=vault/'growth_model.json'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from telethon_sessions import inspect, make_memory_client
from organic_growth import read_model,preview
conf=inspect(vault)
assert conf['api_source']=='private_app_credentials','private_app_credentials_required'
assert len(conf['entries'])==2
assert conf['group']=='@iptvpncode','target_group_changed'
assert not vault.is_symlink() and vault.is_dir() and vault.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid()
assert stat.S_IMODE(vault.stat().st_mode)&0o077==0
assert not path.exists() and not path.is_symlink(),'growth_model_already_present'
async def validate_group():
 client=make_memory_client(conf['entries'][0],conf)
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(),timeout=25)
  assert await asyncio.wait_for(client.is_user_authorized(),timeout=20),'not_authorized'
  group=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_entity(conf['group']),timeout=20)
  assert getattr(group,'megagroup',False) and not getattr(group,'broadcast',False),'target_not_supergroup'
  permissions=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_permissions(group,'me'),timeout=20)
  admin=bool(getattr(permissions,'is_creator',False) or (getattr(permissions,'is_admin',False) and getattr(permissions,'invite_users',False)))
  print('GROWTH_PREFLIGHT','group_supergroup',True,'admin_can_approve',admin,'api_source',conf['api_source'],flush=True)
  assert admin,'group_admin_rights_missing'
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():await client.disconnect()
asyncio.run(validate_group())
tests=subprocess.run([str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_*.py','-q'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
assert tests.returncode==0 and 'Ran 221 tests' in tests.stdout+tests.stderr and 'OK' in tests.stdout+tests.stderr,'baseline_unit_tests_failed'
print('BASELINE_TESTS','221/221_PASS',flush=True)
model={
 'schema':1,
 'target_group':'@iptvpncode',
 'approve_join_requests':True,
 'owned_channel':None,
 'publish_in_owned_channel':False,
 'publisher_account':1
}
serialized=(json.dumps(model,sort_keys=True,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n').encode()
fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as file:
  file.write(serialized);file.flush();os.fsync(file.fileno())
 assert path.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid() and stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)==0o600,'file_private_mode_fail'
 loaded=read_model(vault,conf['group'])
 assert loaded==model,'loaded_model_mismatch'
 result=preview(vault,conf['group'])
 assert result['enabled'] is True and result['join_request_approval'] is True and result['owned_channel_promotion'] is False
 print('GROWTH_MODEL_CREATED',str(path),'mode_0600',True,flush=True)
 print('GROWTH_PREVIEW',json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
 print('PRODUCTION_NOT_RESTARTED',True,flush=True)
 print('CONSENT_GROWTH_CONFIG_PASS',flush=True)
except BaseException:
 if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.read_bytes()==serialized:
  path.unlink()
 print('GROWTH_MODEL_ROLLBACK',flush=True)
 raise
PY
